component.name: Mortar
component.summary: Desktop mod manager for PC games

description.p: Mortar is a desktop mod manager, built for more than one game. It finds your game, installs its mod loader, keeps each set of mods in its own profile, and launches the game with the profile you pick. A profile is shared as a link: whoever opens it gets the same mods, with anything missing installed or queued and every dependency checked.
The games Mortar supports come from its catalog: Stardew Valley and Lethal Company, with mods from Nexus Mods, GitHub and Thunderstore.

screenshot.caption: A profile of 817 mods, with cover art, updates and problems at a glance
Problems explains content conflicts and offers one-click fixes
Startup timings for every mod, so slow loaders stand out
Themes, accent colours and the window background

ul.li: Lethal Company and Valheim: Mortar finds them, installs BepInEx, and installs mods with all their dependencies. Valheim runs natively on Linux with no Proton needed
Thunderstore is a mod source for Lethal Company and Valheim, and CurseForge is a mod source for Stardew Valley
Browse searches every source at once, shows one card per mod, and lets you pick the source by its logo; an empty search lists each source's top mods
A details panel for every mod: description, versions, dependencies and changelog, with filters by category and sort
Load order and Performance tabs for Lethal Company and Valheim: the order plugins load, how long each takes at startup, and frame times and each plugin's cost while you play
While the game runs, each mod shows whether it actually loaded, and Mortar records the game version you played
Skip the intro is a per-game setting

Problems catches much more before you press Play: missing or incompatible plugins, dependency loops, two mods shipping the same plugin, deprecated packages with their replacement, and mods that change the same game code
Crash help names the likely cause of a crash, can find the mod behind it by testing halves of your list, and shares the log with one click
Import profiles from r2modman, Gale, Vortex and Mod Organizer 2, and share as an r2modman code or a Thunderstore modpack
Back up a whole profile to one file, including its saves and mods no site can download again, and restore it as a new profile
Pair two computers with a code to send profiles over your local network, or keep them in step through a sync folder
One Updates list across all sources, with Update all, a restore point and Undo all
A config editor for mods' settings files and their in-game settings menus
Steam Deck: play with the gamepad, larger touch targets, and start games in Game Mode
Mortar finds games installed in Bottles and launches them through it
The browser extension is on the Chrome Web Store for Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers
Settings has Accounts and Source health pages, a per-game source order, and a search that understands common words
The mod list, details panel, profile checks and startup are much faster
Downloads are checked against the site's hash, and a damaged one is dropped so Retry fetches it again
Saves are backed up before every update
Only real crashes are reported as crashes, and Stop asks the game to close before ending it
SMAPI no longer refuses to start after an earlier crash
Errors explain what went wrong instead of saying "Something went wrong"
Add to Steam updates its shortcut instead of adding a second one
A damaged mod archive fails that one install instead of closing Mortar
An update never replaces an unrelated mod that came from the same page
Undo covers config edits and keeps a mod's settings when you roll it back
Menus and tooltips are solid, lists no longer flash on first draw, and keyboard shortcuts no longer take over Enter, Space and the arrow keys
Signed SHA256SUMS and GitHub build provenance for every release file
Signed Flatpak repository: flatpak update now follows new releases
RPM packages are signed, and dnf checks each package's signature
Scoop bucket and Homebrew tap; Mortar leaves updates to them when they installed it
Windows installer records the real version instead of 0.0.1
Light theme: readable accent text, title bar, switches, choice cards, Notes and console
Storage no longer lists the store's index folder as a game
Share dialog tip no longer covers the close button
Flatpak: start at login and profile shortcuts go through the system's own dialogs instead of writing to your home folder
Signed apt, dnf and pacman repository at mortar.rethunk.tech/packages
The Arch package installs cleanly and lists the libraries it needs

description.p: The first public release of Mortar, a mod manager for Stardew Valley.

ul.li: Finds Stardew Valley on Steam (including Flatpak Steam), GOG, Heroic and Lutris, and installs SMAPI for you
Keeps each set of mods in its own profile, with install, update, rollback and undo
Downloads from Nexus Mods and GitHub, including optional files that stay with their main mod
Shares a profile as a link or a .mortar file, or sends it to your other computers over the local network
Checks a profile before Play: missing requirements, broken or outdated mods, conflicts and errors from the last run
Console commands, Generic Mod Config Menu settings and a stream overlay through the Mortar SMAPI Bridge
Light and dark themes, What's new after each update, and updates itself on Windows and the AppImage
Ask for a Nexus sign-in during game setup and from the empty profile
Show file for corrupt settings, Download them for missing bundle mods
Review action, plurals and mod names in update and crash surfaces
The Add menu always offers the downloads folder; the empty profile links it too
Profile templates: save, start a new profile from one, manage
Show release notes with links in What's New
Archive preview, downloads-folder install and collection notes
Extra mods folder, hidden mods, old files and new game folders in the mod list
Removing an untracked folder can be undone from its toast
Retry all failed downloads, extension contact, portable data, backup and history trim, Nexus SSO
Settings for the extra mods folder, hidden mods and old files on update; installs share one runner; crash cause text off Lingui t
Profile templates from a bundle, game settings and launch options
Preview archive listing, manifests and FOMOD without extracting
Apply curator FOMOD choices, bundled configs, instructions and external resources
Record the browser's last contact with the native host
…and 553 more
Drawers close without an exit transition so the next click is not swallowed by the backdrop
A leading outlined field's label is no longer clipped under a dialog title; Start from shows Empty profile
Failed downloads in history read as the plain sentence, with the cause in the tooltip
An older mods load no longer overwrites a newer one when installs finish back to back
Treat a clean-shutdown record anywhere in the previous log as a clean exit
Trim toasts leave out a zero freed size and say when nothing was removed
Trim dialog field labels name the count instead of a literal N
Ask before discarding edits in profile, tool and bug-report dialogs
Problem rows link to the mod they name
Say why locked mod controls are disabled while the game runs
Before you play leads with Update and play when updates are pending, names the profile to switch to, and adding missing mods closes the dialog and opens the queue
Remember last tab, problem sections and table sorts; one large button size
Plain wording, plurals and links across toasts, dialogs, settings and saves
Grid keyboard nav, multi-select delete and toggle, filter empty state, tab shortcuts match tab order, tour Add mods step
Remove and Revert on outside changes ask first and are secondary to the keeping action; disabled while playing says why
…and 584 more
